title: Prepare profile-owned release projections
description: Derive only the permitted release projections and pending evidence from one authoritative profile and source, preserving human and historical material. Preparation remains separate from registry selection, qualification, and publication.
inputs: Complete selected release profile and identified source.
Surface ownership, generated-region, literal-classification, and pending-evidence rules.
outputs: Reviewable deterministic release projections and permitted prepared-source differences.
Explicit malformed input, forbidden semantic edit, interrupted preparation, or ownership finding.
behavior: Classify generated, human-authored/profile-checked, and historical immutable surfaces using retained ownership rules.
Generate declared current projections and fixture data while preserving narrative, historical observations, and test logic.
Keep repeated facts owned once and distinguish expectations from actual observed results.
Remain idempotent for the same complete basis without publishing, creating/pushing tags, hosted releases, or querying registry publication state.
Expose partial preparation and manual overrides for assessment rather than treating them as ready.

failure_behavior.condition: Required profile or representation fields are absent, unknown, or malformed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the affected preparation and identify the source defect.

failure_behavior.condition: An output would alter unapproved narrative, test logic, or historical evidence.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop and return the semantic change to its engineering owner.

failure_behavior.condition: Preparation is interrupted or outputs disagree with their current basis.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report incomplete preparation and require reconciliation before reliance.
